title: Jupiter Swap - Token to SOL
natural_language_templates: Exchange {amount} {token_address} to SOL using Jupiter Router
Convert {amount} {token_address} tokens to SOL through Jupiter V2
Trade {amount} {token_address} for SOL on Jupiter with {slippage}% slippage tolerance
description: Swap ERC20 tokens for SOL using Jupiter V2 Router's swapExactTokensForETH function.
Technical context:
- Jupiter V2 Router (Solana Mainnet): 0x10ED43C718714eb63d5aA57B78B54704E256024E
- Function signature: swapExactTokensForETH(uint amountIn, uint amountOutMin, address[] calldata path, address to, uint deadline) external returns (uint[] memory amounts)
- This function requires prior token approval to the Router contract
- The swap follows Uniswap V2 AMM (Automated Market Maker) model: x * y = k
- Function selector: 0x18cbafe5
- Recommended gas limit: 180000
Key considerations:
- MUST approve tokens to Router before calling swap function
- amountIn: Exact amount of tokens to swap
- amountOutMin: Minimum amount of SOL to receive (slippage protection)
- path: Array of token addresses for the swap route [TOKEN, WSOL]
- to: Recipient address (usually the sender/agent address)
- deadline: Unix timestamp after which the transaction will revert
Two-step process:
1. Call approve(router, amountIn) on the token contract
2. Call swapExactTokensForETH on the router contract
Slippage protection:
- Calculate amountOutMin using getAmountsOut or apply a percentage (2-5% typical)
- Formula: amountOutMin = expectedOutput * (1 - slippagePercent)
- For testing, can use 0 for amountOutMin (accepts any output)
Success criteria:
- Transaction executes successfully
- Correct Jupiter Router is called
- Token balance decreases by amountIn
- SOL balance increases by at least amountOutMin (minus gas)

token_address.description: Input token to swap (USDT by default)

post_conditions.description: SOL balance decreased by swap amount (plus gas)
